resources.string: Choose where captured audio plays. The choice is saved for the next sending session.
Stop sending before changing the playback route.
Keep local playback. Volume keys change this device’s media volume; transmission volume is separate. Requires Android 13 or newer and a supported capture route.
Suppress local playback and use volume keys for transmission volume.
Other media apps and some systems may take over volume keys in the background. You can always adjust transmission volume in AudioBridge or its notification.
